questions.response: E-SHRAM: National database registration for unorganized workers. Provides benefits and portability. Required: Name, Mobile, Email, DOB, Gender, City, State, Employment details, Occupation, Work experience, Worker category, Scheme type, Bank account, IFSC, Address, Pincode, NCO code, Skill certificate, Blood group, Bank link status. One-time registration, benefits for life.

PM Kisan Samman Nidhi: Direct cash transfer to farmers. ₹6,000/year (₹2,000 quarterly) support. Required: Name, Mobile, Email, DOB, Gender, City, State, Address, Pincode, Land size, Primary crop, Bank account, IFSC, Aadhaar linked with bank. For farmers with land. Eligibility: Own cultivable land.

Labour Welfare Schemes: Government support for workers. Coverage includes accident, disability, pension, maternity benefits. Required: Name, Mobile, Email, DOB, Gender, City, State, Employment details, Occupation, Experience, Worker category, Scheme type, Bank account, IFSC, Address, Pincode, Labour category, Union registration, Years in profession, Monthly wage. Protects worker rights and livelihoods.

Scholarship Schemes: Financial aid for education. Covers tuition, books, living costs. Required: Name, Mobile, Email, DOB, Gender, City, State, Address, Pincode, Education level, Institution name, Course name, Annual family income, Previous marks, Category (general/SC/ST), Bank account, IFSC. Merit and need-based scholarships available.

E-SHRAM benefits: Accident insurance coverage (₹2 lakh), workplace portability of benefits, easier access to govt schemes, labor compliance benefits, emergency support. Free registration with lifetime benefits for registered workers.

PM Kisan eligibility: Own agricultural land, Indian farmer, not receiving other govt pensions, not salaried govt employee, not high-income earner. Marginal and small farmers prioritized. Check land ownership and Aadhaar link status.

E-SHRAM registration: Visit CSC (Common Service Center) or apply online at eshram.gov.in. Provide personal/employment details, occupation, bank account. One-time process. Get ESHRAM ID for tracking benefits. Free, open to all unorganized workers.
PM Kisan requires bank account linked with Aadhaar for direct transfer. Link through your bank or UIDAI portal. Without linking, cannot receive benefits. Update details at uidai.gov.in or bank.

Scholarship application: Visit Services > Social Security > Scholarship. Fill education details, income proof, marks. Upload documents (Aadhaar, PAN, passport, certificates). Assess merit & need. Usually decides within 2-3 months.

Labour Welfare covers: Workplace accident insurance (₹5-10 lakh), disability benefits, maternity allowance, death benefit, pension contribution, medical insurance. Protections vary by scheme and worker category.
Check PM Kisan status: Visit pmkisan.gov.in, enter Aadhaar or account number. Or visit bank/CSC. Check Submissions section here for FinTech application tracking. Payments typically monthly/quarterly.

Can apply multiple schemes as long as you meet eligibility. Some schemes have restrictions: can't receive multiple similar pensions, can't double-dip subsidies. E-SHRAM + PM Kisan can combine if both eligible. Check scheme terms.
